**NET-TOOLS 0.9.0**: 42 new tools (215 in total) — record generators, email and DNS checks, service probes, web and client tests, BGP helpers and network calculators.

## New tools

**Generators** (run in your browser)
- **SPF flattener**: replaces includes with the IP ranges they resolve to, merges ranges and splits long results over chained `_spfN` records.
- **DMARC, DKIM and MTA-STS generators**: records, key pairs (the private key stays in the browser), policy files and TLS-RPT.
- **DS / DNSKEY tool**, **NSEC3 hash calculator**, **nsupdate / TSIG builder** and a **zone file linter**.
- **SSH key & SSHFP tool**: fingerprints, `authorized_keys` / `known_hosts` parsing and SSHFP records.

**Email and DNS checks**
- **Email provider detector**, **email address validator** (no mail is sent) and **DKIM signature verifier** for a pasted message or `.eml` file.
- **DNS snapshot & diff** (kept in your browser), **subdomain takeover check**, **lookalike domain finder**, **AD / Kerberos DC locator** and **ACME readiness check**.

**Service probes**
- **UDP service probe** (DNS, NTP, SNMPv3, SIP, STUN, IKE, QUIC, OpenVPN, NetBIOS, TFTP), **IPsec / IKE probe**, **SIP server check**, **LDAP / LDAPS check**, **remote access check** (RDP, VNC, SSH) and **post-quantum TLS check**.
- **Reverse traceroute** from Globalping probes back to your own IP.
- **RADIUS tester** (LAN profile only).

**Web and client**
- **Webhook / request inspector**, **social preview checker**, **broken link checker**, **origin vs CDN compare** and a **reverse proxy config generator** (nginx, Caddy, Traefik, HAProxy).
- **Expiry watchlist** for certificates and domains (kept in your browser).
- **VoIP quality test**: a voice-like packet stream between your browser and the server, with jitter, late packets and a MOS score. It runs over a WebSocket (TCP), so lost packets show as late packets rather than as loss.
- The speed test is now also found as the **bufferbloat test**.

**BGP and calculators**
- **Prefix-list generator** for Cisco IOS/IOS-XR, Juniper, Arista, FRR, MikroTik, BIRD and OpenBGPD from IRR data.
- **Prefix watch** (kept in your browser): unexpected origins, foreign more-specifics and RPKI status for your prefixes.
- **ROA & ASPA helper**: a minimal ROA plan for Krill or your RIR portal, and an ASPA builder with AS-path verification.
- **Fiber link budget**, **Wi-Fi throughput estimator**, **Wi-Fi channel planner**, **cabling & transceiver reference**, **firewall object converter**, **capture filter builder** and **log parser**.

## Improvements

- DNS lookup accepts the NSEC3PARAM record type.
- **Fix**: tools that fill several fields at once no longer lose all but the last value in the URL.

## Upgrade

```bash
cd net-tools-docker
git pull
docker compose pull && docker compose up -d
```

No configuration changes are required. If `NETTOOLS_VERSION` is pinned in `.env`, set it to `0.9.0`.

**Reverse proxy in front of NET-TOOLS**: the VoIP quality test uses a WebSocket on `/api/v1/voip/ws`. Your proxy must pass WebSocket upgrades and keep the original `Host` header (the server only accepts connections from its own pages). Most proxies (Traefik, Caddy, Nginx Proxy Manager with "Websockets support") do this by default.

Images: `ghcr.io/digibaro/nettools-web:0.9.0`, `ghcr.io/digibaro/nettools-api:0.9.0` (amd64 + arm64, SBOM and provenance). Full list: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/digibaro/net-tools-docker/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Notes

- Watchlists (expiry watchlist, prefix watch, DNS snapshots) live only in your browser: there is no server-side storage, monitoring or alerting.
- Server probes (UDP, IKE, SIP, LDAP, remote access, takeover, lookalike, broken links) go through the same target policy and limits as the other server tools; check only hosts and domains you manage.
- Email addresses and messages are sent in a POST body, so they do not appear in web server access logs.
- New dependencies: `github.com/emersion/go-msgauth` (DKIM verification) and `github.com/coder/websocket` (VoIP test).
